name: caffein
description: Fire and Pollution Webapp with Simulation

scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm run setup:venv && pnpm run setup:backend
scripts.setup:venv: python3 -m venv venv && echo 'Virtual environment created at ./venv'
scripts.dev:backend: bash -c 'source venv/bin/activate && cd backend && python app.py'
